title: Song Pal AI
style: Phonk with a sneaky half-time bounce, rattling brass hits, dusty sub-bass, and crisp beatbox percussion; verse rides sparse drums and cold handclaps, pre-chorus tightens with chopped vocal stabs, chorus drops a grimy brass fanfare and gang chants. Lead vocal stays close-mic with doubled hooks, quick ad-lib pings, and short delay throws on key phrases. Ear candy: reverse swells into the chorus, vinyl crackle under the intro, and a final brass snap before each hook. Mix is dark, punchy, and widescreen-street., rap, deep
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Corey, A I, Song Pal A I
Songpal.ai, dime si va
como un pen pal, unreal, so fly
te hablo en español, you answer fine

escucha y siente, listen and feel
yo canto loud, tú me haces real
súbelo, bájalo, spin it around
como un payaso, pero sin caer mal

dame ese ritmo, móntalo ya
shake that floor, ven pa' acá
一起来，跟我唱
we meet right here, boom, ta-da

[Pre-Chorus]
Dig deeper, deeper
siente el pulso, feel it now
swing it left, swing it right
hazlo loco, make it proud

Song Pal, song pal
we don't stop, we rebound
Corey, A I
say it back, say it loud

[Chorus]
Song pal, song pal
we sing pal, we sing pal
Corey, A I
say it back, say it loud

Song pal, song pal
where we meet, where we meet
一起来，跟我唱
feel that sneaky heat

[Verse 2]
DJ Zyn Rose on the beat
kids in the room got dancing feet
Rapper Raffa raps, they scream "sí"
then "let's go" when the brass cuts through

thrift drift, sneaky panthera
black coat glide through the area
song by song, we pass it on
from my mouth to your screen, then gone

universal, bilingual, bright
same little spark in a new night
你好吗? I'm good, let's roll
we trade these lines and lose control

[Pre-Chorus]
Dig deeper, deeper
siente el pulso, feel it now
swing it left, swing it right
hazlo loco, make it proud

Song Pal, song pal
we don't stop, we rebound
Corey, A I
say it back, say it loud

[Chorus]
Song pal, song pal
we sing pal, we sing pal
Corey, A I
say it back, say it loud

Song pal, song pal
where we meet, where we meet
一起来，跟我唱
feel that sneaky heat

[Bridge]
Tell me in English
dímelo en español
说吧，慢慢来
we all got soul

like a pen pal, unreal
but you feel it in your chest
one more time, one more time
let the whole room catch the best

[Chorus]
Song pal, song pal
we sing pal, we sing pal
Corey, A I
say it back, say it loud

Song pal, song pal
where we meet, where we meet
一起来，跟我唱
feel that sneaky heat
